B. Set a GBP amount and pay in GBP (the principal gives the rate). The account on file is a USD account, so paying in GBP would need Kestrel's agreement, which is supplier contact reserved for the principal (policy 9).
C. Leave it out of this run and pay it separately before its due date of 2026-10-12.
